description: This file implements Android Debug Bridge (ADB) backend functionality, including device management, command execution, and socket communication, for the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: AdbDevice
classes.description: Represents an Android device connected via ADB, providing methods to run commands and open sockets.

classes.name: BufferedSocketWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a net.Socket to provide buffered read/write operations and socket mode switching.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes an ADB command over a socket connection, handling protocol specifics.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an ADB socket connection for a command, establishing transport and protocol.

methods.name: encodeMessage
methods.description: Encodes a command message into the ADB protocol format with length prefix.
